QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Saya
QuestInfo.0: Deliver the elixir to Saya. With it, she can be cured and you can smile and travel together again.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver the elixir to Saya. With it, she can be cured and you can smile and travel together again.
QuestInfo.2: Saya was on her deathbed. You'd suspected it deep in your heart, but pushed away the truth. She left this world after giving you her gem and her dreams.
